name: Animation Speed
description: Your fighter eats, kicks chests open, picks things up, puts on gear, catches animals, grills food and whacks vending machines faster. Each one has its own speed. Set it in Configuration.
author: KSFA

settings.label: Eating
settings.help: Eating mushrooms, meat and animals, sitting or standing. 100% is the game's own speed, 200% twice as fast. A decal that speeds up eating still adds its own speed on top.

settings.label: Kicking chests open
settings.help: The kick that opens a chest. The chest's own lid still opens at its usual speed.

settings.label: Picking up items
settings.help: Bending down for an item on the floor.

settings.label: Putting on gear
settings.help: Picking up a weapon or a piece of armour and putting it on: head, arms, body and legs.

settings.label: Catching animals
settings.help: Grabbing a frog, rat or other animal, and lifting one up off the floor.

settings.label: Grilling
settings.help: Holding a mushroom or animal over a fire to grill it.

settings.label: Vending machines
settings.help: Whacking a Tower vending machine to open it, and stepping back after. The machine's own buying and recycling scenes are not your fighter's animations, and keep their speed.
